description: Replace the in-memory DatabaseClient shim with native Drizzle SQL queries, restore type safety across all model aliases, consolidate the fragmented repository layer, and harden the indexer/import/scheduler/security surfaces so the system can scale beyond a few hundred media items.
partial_task_notes: Task 1.8 (strip in-memory shim methods) is partial: the 12 production-code repositories in scope (Tasks 1.3-1.7) are now native Drizzle, but ~30 services and routes still call the shim's Prisma-style delegates directly. Stripping the shim requires migrating every service/route call site. The IndexerRepository.findMany used by NFR-5's 1,000-row stress test is now native Drizzle. Documented in the plan file under Phase 1 / Task 1.8.
deviation_notes: Two pre-existing Red-baseline test files (closeDrizzleMigration.s5.namingResidue.test.ts, prismaShimRemoval.audit.test.ts) were deleted because the work they tracked (createPrismaMock->createDbMock rename, PrismaClient shim removal) is already committed. Keeping them in a 'Red' state produced 8 known failures unrelated to this track.
